title: Inert-active factorization and orthogonality in a symmetric infinity operad
statement:
Use quasicategories, mapping spaces and coherent triangles of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], cocartesian edges of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and symmetric infinity operads of [lem-coef-symmetric-operadic-fibration-recognition]. Let $p:P\to N(\mathsf{Fin}_*)$ be a small symmetric infinity operad. A pointed map is active when the inverse image of its basepoint consists only of the basepoint; call an edge of $P$ active when its image is active. Inert edges of $P$ are the $p$-cocartesian edges over inert pointed maps, as in the cited definition.

Every edge $b:x\to y$ admits a coherent factorization $x\xrightarrow{i}z\xrightarrow{a}y$, with $i$ inert and $a$ active. Moreover, for every inert edge $i:x\to y$ and active edge $a:u\to v$, the composition-induced comparison of spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_P(y,u)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_P(x,u)\times^h_{\operatorname{Map}_P(x,v)}\operatorname{Map}_P(y,v)$$
is an equivalence. Here the maps to $\operatorname{Map}_P(x,v)$ are postcomposition with $a$ and precomposition with $i$. The homotopy pullback retains the specified homotopy making a square commute. Thus the space of diagonal fillers of each coherent square with left side $i$ and right side $a$, including its two compatible triangles and all higher compatibility data, is contractible. The assertion includes arity zero.
